content: 1 A tribute vnto God O ye sonnes of princes: attribute vnto God glory and strength. 2 Geue to God glory due vnto his name: worship God with holy honour. 3 The voyce of God is aboue waters: it is the Lorde of glory that thundreth, it is God that ruleth the sea. 4 The voyce of God is with power: the voyce of God is with honour. 5 The voyce of God breaketh the Cedar trees: yea God breaketh the Cedars of Libanus. 6 And he maketh them to skip like a calfe: Libanus also and Sirion like a young vnicorne. 7 The voyce of God casteth out flambes of fire: 8 the voyce of God maketh the wyldernesse to tremble, God maketh the wyldernesse of Cades to tremble. 9 The voyce of God maketh Hindes to cast their calfe, and maketh woods to be bare: therefore euery man setteth foorth his glory in his temple. 10 God sitteth in the flud: and God wil sit king for euer. 11 God wyll geue strength vnto his people: God wyll blesse his people in peace.
